international.title: Suspect in custody after bomb found at Illinois ethanol plant
international.summary: The FBI is leading the investigation into the Biourja Renewables incident after it led to a temporary evacuation Authorities investigating a bomb found recently at an ethanol production plant in Peoria, Illinois, have taken a suspect into custody, according to the mayor there.
